body:
**Tier:** T4

**Why:** C-641-2 (Opus audit of #641). `GET /v1/coach/payments/purchases`, `/purchases/:id` and `/failed` returned raw `ClientPurchase` rows, which carry the CLIENT's cached Stripe PaymentIntent `stripe_client_secret` and customer `stripe_ephemeral_key` (plus checkout-session / customer / subscription ids and idempotency keys). A coach could read and replay a client's payment credentials. The same raw-row pattern was on `/v1/coach/payments/earnings` (ledger rows with idempotency keys and connected-account ids) and `/v1/coach/packages/:id/subscribers` (raw purchases, same secrets).

OR-112-19 (operator ruling, extension round): `GET /v1/checkout/purchases` (the client's own list) also returned raw rows, so a client got the cached PaymentIntent `stripe_client_secret` / `stripe_ephemeral_key` back on purchases that need no client action (paid, active, canceled), plus Stripe ids, the idempotency key, the coach's connected account id and grant metadata. While closing it, `GET /v1/coach/purchases` (`CoachPurchasesController`, the older coach revenue feed) turned out to have the same C-641-2 leak and is fixed here too.

**T4 trigger scan:** money / payment credentials exposure on coach-facing routes and the client purchase list: yes (this is the fix). Auth, RLS, migrations, env, feature flags, package.json: none touched.

**T3 trigger scan:** response shape of six coach routes and one client route narrows (fields removed, none renamed). Mobile on main does not call `/purchases`, `/purchases/:id`, `/failed`; `/earnings` keeps every field the app reads (`id, purchase_id, kind, payee_user_id, amount_cents, currency, status, reversed_cents, created_at, posted_at`); `/subscribers` is not consumed yet (mobile TODO, different shape). Client `GET /v1/checkout/purchases`: mobile main (f34b5b99) types and reads only `id, package_id, status, entitlement_active, access_expires_at, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, created_at` (`src/api/clientPaymentsApi.ts` `ClientPurchase`, `getPaymentStatus`, `PurchaseUnpackScreen.buildReceipt`); every one is kept. Mobile reads client secrets only from the mint responses (`POST /v1/checkout/sessions` in `PackageSelectionSheet`, `CheckoutSessionResponse` in `packagesApi`), never from purchase rows, so the secret is dropped from the list for every status. Mobile does not call `GET /v1/coach/purchases`.

**Bounded T1:** none.

**Builder-owner:** S-COACH-BE-2 (agent 112); OR-112-19 round: B-SECRETS-2 (agent 112).

**What changed**
- `src/checkout/coach-payments.select.ts` (new): explicit allow-lists `COACH_PURCHASE_SELECT`, `COACH_LEDGER_SELECT`, `COACH_TRANSFER_SELECT`, `COACH_DUNNING_SELECT` (typed with `satisfies Prisma.*Select`), and `COACH_FORBIDDEN_FIELD_PATTERN` shared by the regression spec. New model columns stay private until added here on purpose.
- `CoachPaymentOpsController`: `purchases`, `purchases/:id` (purchase, split ledger, transfers, dunning), `failed` (purchase + dunning) and `earnings` entries all use the allow-lists. `purchases/:id` now reads the ledger with an allow-listed select instead of `SplitLedgerService.findByPurchase` (same ordering).
- `PackagesService.listSubscribers` (`GET /v1/coach/packages/:id/subscribers`): allow-listed select; `SubscribersPage.subscribers` typed as `CoachSubscriberRow`.
- OR-112-19: `src/checkout/client-purchases.select.ts` (new): `CLIENT_PURCHASE_SELECT` allow-list (id, client/coach/package ids, amount, currency, billing_type, status, entitlement_active, access_expires_at, current_period_end, cancel_at_period_end, canceled_at, last_error, source, created_at, updated_at) and `ClientPurchaseView`. `CheckoutService.listForClient` (`GET /v1/checkout/purchases`) selects it. There is no client `GET /v1/checkout/purchases/:id`; the other client purchase reads were checked: `/purchases/:id/drops` selects `{ id }` only, `/sessions/:id/confirm` returns `{ paid, status, package_name }`, `claim-free` / `claim-grant` return a shaped grant response, the public thank-you page returns shaped fields. A payment still awaiting client action resumes through `POST /v1/checkout/payment-intent` with the same idempotency key, which replays the cached secret to its owner only (unchanged, covered by a test).
- OR-112-19 (adjacent): `CheckoutService.listForCoach` (`GET /v1/coach/purchases`) selects `COACH_PURCHASE_SELECT`; `CoachPurchaseView` type exported next to it.
- Grep scope: `rg "stripe_client_secret|stripe_ephemeral_key" src` and every `clientPurchase.find*` reachable from a coach route. Other coach reads already use explicit selects (coach-connect, command-center LTV, package contents, coach-money). `package-push` reads raw rows internally only (ids), never returned.
- Payment method details are not stored on these models; the allow-list comment pins brand/last4 as the only permitted additions.

**Acceptance evidence**
- `test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts` (new): a Prisma double that returns the FULL stored row (with planted client secret, ephemeral key, idempotency keys, Stripe ids) whenever a query has no `select`; each of the five routes (coach and owner for `/purchases/:id`) is called and the JSON response is scanned recursively for any secret-like key and for the planted values. Fails on main before the fix (6 assertions across 5 routes), passes after.
- `heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts`: 3 suites, 131 tests passed.
- OR-112-19: `test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts` (new): real `CheckoutController` / `CoachPurchasesController` over the real `CheckoutService`, Prisma double that returns the FULL stored row when a query has no `select`. Planted secrets on a settled, a pending (awaiting client action), a canceled and a $0 grant row. Asserts no secret-like key or planted value on `GET /v1/checkout/purchases` (both pages of a paginated read) and `GET /v1/coach/purchases`, every mobile-read field kept with its stored value, the allow-list names no secret-like field, and the payment-intent replay still returns the cached secret to its owner. Fails on ea919f6b (3 tests: client list, client pagination, coach feed), passes after.
- `heavy.sh npx jest --runInBand test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts test/checkout.service.spec.ts test/checkout-buyer-drops.spec.ts test/payment-ops.controller.spec.ts test/packages.service.spec.ts test/dunning-v2-lockout-allowlist-route-table.spec.ts`: 7 suites, 207 tests passed. Scoped strict `tsc --noEmit` over the touched files: clean.
- r75 banned-cast checker on the range: clean. Prettier/eslint on changed files: clean.

**Promotion triggers:** none expected (already T4). Re-grade only if a mobile build is found reading a field this PR removes from a client or coach purchase response.

### Fix round

| Finding | What changed | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| C-641-2 | Allow-list selects on every coach payments route + subscribers; shared forbidden-field pattern | ea919f6b | `test/coach-payments-field-select.spec.ts` |
| OR-112-19 client purchases secret | `GET /v1/checkout/purchases` uses `CLIENT_PURCHASE_SELECT` (no secret for any status; mobile never reads it); `GET /v1/coach/purchases` uses `COACH_PURCHASE_SELECT` | 32f7ede4 | `test/client-purchases-field-select.spec.ts` (fails on ea919f6b, passes after) |
